scope: Exactly one current official Base POOL Prize Vault, with two ordinary deposit/mint calls and both canonical standard/bounded withdraw and redeem overloads. No factory-created address discovery/automatic authorization, external claimer, hook, permit, liquidation or administrative capability.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official current Base deployment table explicitly lists POOL Prize Vault at this exact address and separately lists deprecated factory/claimer addresses. The selected POOL vault is not in the deprecated table. Current official website describes saving/prize deposits and withdrawals and links developer documentation. Reviewed sources have no retirement/shutdown notice for this selected vault. No DAU, fresh execution or vault TVL is claimed; website user-count marketing is not treated as DAU.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official exact POOL Prize Vault address bound to full deployed PrizeVault ABI/source via Sourcify exact_match. Sourcify identifies no proxy. Published constructor and immutable values identify Prize POOL and underlying POOL asset, 18 decimals, staking yield vault, prize pool and TWAB controller. Constructor initial claimer was old address now separately deprecated in docs; current configured claimer is not inferred from initial constructor, and no claim function is admitted. Deprecation of a separate claimer/factory is not assumed to deprecate this currently listed vault. No fresh RPC state or runtime-code verification.

abiEvidence.evidence: Published Sourcify verification response; match labels retained exactly. This review does not perform a fresh RPC code, storage, or implementation identity check.

selectedFunctions.label: Deposit POOL for prize shares
warnings: Base Prize POOL vault only: 0x6b5a5c55e9dd4bb502ce25bbfbaa49b69cf7e4dd. Underlying asset is POOL 0xd652c5425aea2afd5fb142e120fecf79e18fafc3 (18 decimals), not USDC. Immutable underlying yield vault is StakingVault 0x854f3d91e53d0fc9dba9822bc74f574c7380436d. No other factory-created vault is admitted.

Prize shares are principal claims and prize eligibility records, not a fixed yield token. Yield supports prizes rather than guaranteed individual yield; winning and principal protection are not guaranteed. POOL price, underlying yield source, smart-contract, governance and liquidity risks remain.

Deposit/mint need separate underlying POOL allowance to this exact prize vault. Withdrawal/redeem burn owner shares and pay receiver; caller != owner needs share allowance. All values are raw token/share units. Standard flows provide no caller-specified slippage bound; the four-argument overloads enforce maxShares or minAssets respectively.

TWAB supply limits and lossy-deposit checks can reject deposits. Withdrawals depend on underlying redemption limits and funds; undercollateralization/rounding or depleted yield buffer can reduce proceeds. No fresh runtime balance or successful execution is established.

No prize claim endpoint is admitted: claimPrize is restricted to the configured claimer, not an ordinary winner function. Custom hooks, permit/depositWithPermit, liquidation callbacks, sponsorship, token approvals/transfers, ownership and fee administration are excluded.

Sourcify reports exact_match for this non-proxy deployment and retains immutable bindings/constructor evidence. Evidence is inventory only, not fresh RPC runtime availability or legal eligibility; independent authorization, pauses, canonical decoding and signing controls still apply. No DAU or vault-TVL claim is made.

semantics: PrizeVault.sol 481-513: deposit/mint and ordinary withdraw/redeem go through internal asset-pull/share-mint and owner share-burn/payout paths.
PrizeVault.sol 583-611: canonical four-argument withdraw enforces _maxShares; four-argument redeem enforces _minAssets. Both retain owner allowance and normal withdrawal semantics.
PrizeVault.sol 963-1028: nonzero assets/shares, asset transferFrom caller, underlying immutable yieldVault mint, TWAB limit, loss check, and caller/owner share allowance on exit.
Claimable.sol claimPrize is onlyClaimer and may call registered user hooks; neither direct claimPrize nor arbitrary setHooks is admitted.
PrizeVault.sol transferTokensOut/verifyTokensIn are onlyLiquidationPair; claimYieldFeeShares onlyYieldFeeRecipient; privileged settlement excluded.
